note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Kim Dae-jung's NCNP-ULD government, two years after the 1997 financial crisis), not measured data. Business influence reflects the large conglomerates (chaebol) then under government-led restructuring; unions are militant but split between two national federations; the military is under civilian control since the 1990s but remains large because of conscription and the armistice with the North.

interest_groups.note: Layoffs after the 1997-1998 crisis strained relations with the government.
